messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the UR10e manual, if the Teach Pendant is detached or disconnected from the robot, does the Emergency Stop button on the Teach Pendant remain active?

response.text: Secondo il manuale del UR10e, se il Teach Pendant viene staccato o disconnesso dal robot, il pulsante di arresto di emergenza sul Teach Pendant rimane attivo?
